title: Smooth cut-off equal to 1 on a shrunken lattice face and vanishing on all parallel lattice faces
statement: Let n, N ∈ ℕ, ρ > 0, δ > 0, z ∈ ℤ^N and let α : Fin n ↪o Fin N be a strictly increasing multi-index with A := range α. Let K := {x ∈ ℝ^N : ρ(z_i + δ) ≤ x_i ≤ ρ(z_i + 1 − δ) for i ∈ A, and x_i = ρ z_i for i ∉ A}. Then there is a C^∞ function φ : ℝ^N → ℝ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ) with compact support such that 0 ≤ φ ≤ 1 everywhere, φ = 1 on K, and φ = 0 on every lattice face latticeFace ρ (z', α) = ρ(z' + F_α) with z' ∈ ℤ^N, z' ≠ z.
lean_statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (ρ δ : ℝ) (z : Fin N → ℤ) (α : SimonMultiIndex n N), 0 < ρ → 0 < δ → ∃ φ : Eucl N → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) φ ∧ HasCompactSupport φ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x ∧ φ x ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ x : Eucl N, (∀ i : Fin N, (i ∈ range α → ρ * ((z i : ℝ) + δ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ ρ * ((z i : ℝ) + 1 - δ)) ∧ (i ∉ range α → x i = ρ * (z i : ℝ))) → φ x = 1) ∧ ∀ z' : Fin N → ℤ, z' ≠ z → ∀ x ∈ latticeFace ρ ((z', α) : LatticeFaceIndex n N), φ x = 0
